_readme: SpeakLoop user settings. Copy this file to settings.json in the same directory and edit it by hand; restart the app to apply. Delete a key (or the whole file) to use the built-in default. Keys starting with '_' are ignored and may be used as comments.
_max_record_seconds: Hard limit on a single recording, in seconds (a safety stop for a stuck key). Minimum 1.
_color_theme: UI colors: 'dark' (the default) or 'light'. Each theme is one <name>_schema.json; the shipped ones live in speakloop/themes/, and a file of the same name in config/themes/ wins over them. A color missing from the file falls back to the built-in dark palette.
_llm_backend: Which model server the app talks to: 'llama-server' (the default) starts the official llama.cpp binary itself with the GGUF model in models/; 'lm-studio' uses an already-running LM Studio app (see lm_studio_host).
_lm_studio_host: Address of the LM Studio server, used by the 'lm-studio' backend only. Accepts 'host', 'host:port' or a full 'http://host:port' URL; the port defaults to 1234. Point it at another machine to run LM Studio on it.
_llama_server_path: The llama-server binary to start, for a build you manage yourself. An empty value (the default) uses bin/llama/, where 'python -m speakloop.llama_server_fetch' installs it, and falls back to a llama-server on PATH. A relative path is resolved against this directory.
_external_model_path: GGUF model file for the 'llama-server' backend (unused with 'lm-studio'). Add this key only to point the app at a model of your own: with the key absent it finds the downloaded one in models/ by itself. A relative path is resolved against this directory.
_external_n_ctx: Context window size (--ctx-size) of the local GGUF model. Add this key only to override the value hardware detection wrote into hardware_config.json. Minimum 256.
